name: RRT Target-Specific Deep Scan Engine
change_reason: Il primo run live ha mostrato che 250 query search-engine per 10 aziende sono ridondanti, costose e non necessarie quando il sito ufficiale espone sitemap/navigation/service pages.
saturation_strategy: 3. Target keyword scan on discovered official pages
4. Search-engine site: query only for unresolved target dimensions
5. Follow dedicated pages surfaced by those queries
6. NOT_FOUND only after unresolved dimension exhausts the adaptive protocol

adaptive_query_budget.principle: More official-page coverage, fewer search-engine calls.

saturation_pass_conditions: each scored positive level has evidence_id
each zero has explicit search trace proving target-specific unresolved search
anti_gaming: A target cannot pass merely because one broad search query was executed.
